conviction_note: The one line the sweep flagged as most repriceable -- cash runway -- was already published on 2026-08-14 as 'through Q1 2028', so this print is unusually information-poor; what is left is a stale 30-June balance sheet that predates both of the company's cash events, an unconfirmed closing condition on the $75m that the whole runway rests on, and a first-ever first-patient date for TELLOMAK-3 that is later than prior guidance implied, partly offset by PACIFIC-9 optionality 13 days out; sized small because the evidence set is modest and the name has no option chain and ~$49k/day of turnover, so nothing here deserves a big number.

findings.finding: The H1 2026 balance sheet date is 30 June 2026, which predates BOTH of Innate's cash events (the Sobi $75m upfront announced 10 Aug and the EUR 30m placement priced 14 Aug), so the headline cash line will be roughly EUR 12-13m against ~EUR 20m of financial liabilities -- i.e. negative net cash -- derived from the company's own disclosed trajectory of EUR 44.8m at 31-Dec-2025 and EUR 25.4m at 31-Mar-2026 with runway guided only to 'end of Q3 2026'.
findings.why_not_priced: Every piece of coverage since 10 August anchors on the forward pro-forma number ('runway through Q1 2028'); no one has published the backward-looking 30-June figure the statutory H1 must actually carry, and it is the first hard cash number since 31 March. If the market had focused on it there would be a visible sell-side note reconciling June-30 cash to the pro-forma, and the stock would not be rallying into the print on 3x normal volume with no wire story. On a tape that trades ~25k ADS a day and is heavily retail, a headline 'cash position of EUR 12.x million' prints before the US open and is read literally for hours before the 08:00 EDT call reframes it.
findings.independence: The 31-Dec-2025 anchor (EUR 44.8m cash, EUR 22.6m financial liabilities, net cash EUR 25.5m) comes from a different release: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260325193268/en/Innate-Pharma-Reports-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results-and-Business-Update (2026-03-25). The EUR 70.4m at 30-Jun-2025 comparative is from https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250916779361/en/Innate-Pharma-Reports-First-Half-2025-Business-Update-and-Financial-Results (2025-09-16).

findings.finding: The Sobi USD 75m upfront -- the entire basis of the 'cash runway through Q1 2028' guidance -- is stated in the deal release as 'payable on closing', with closing 'subject to closing conditions, including the receipt of transaction related anti-trust clearance', and 37 days after signing NEITHER Innate's own press-release index NOR Sobi's carries any completion announcement.
findings.why_not_priced: The market is carrying the 14-Aug pro-forma runway as a settled fact. It is not: if the transaction is still pending when the H1 statements are authorised for issue, the funding actually committed at that date is only ~EUR 12-13m of June-30 cash plus EUR 27.6m of net placement proceeds, i.e. ~EUR 40m against a burn that ran EUR 19.4m in Q1-2026 alone -- under twelve months, which is the specific condition that forces a going-concern material-uncertainty disclosure in a French semi-annual report reviewed by the statutory auditors. Nobody is modelling a going-concern paragraph on a stock whose last five weeks of coverage read 'funded to Q1 2028'; if they were, the 11 Aug Leerink upgrade to Outperform would have carried the condition and the stock would not have closed the gap to the EUR 1.70 placement price. This is genuinely two-sided: if the release instead announces the closing, that is a positive, which is why the band is wide and crosses zero.
findings.independence: Sobi's own press-release index is a fully independent issuer and shows the 10 Aug signing but no closing between then and today: https://www.sobi.com/en/press-releases (checked 2026-09-16). NOTE: this finding shares the 14-Aug pricing release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001598599/000162828026057935/exhibit993.htm, 2026-08-14, 'expected to extend the Company's projected cash runway through Q1 2028') with the framing of finding 1 -- treat the Q1-2028 guidance as one document read two ways, not two pieces of evidence.

findings.finding: At the H.C. Wainwright fireside chat on 2026-09-14 management gave, for the first time publicly, a first-patient-enrolled date for the confirmatory Phase 3 TELLOMAK-3 of 'early 2027' -- against prior public guidance of trial initiation in H1 2026 (Nov-2025) and then H2 2026 (May-2026) -- and the trial still has no ClinicalTrials.gov registration of any kind.
findings.why_not_priced: It exists only in a conference-transcript service two days old, has not appeared in any company press release, and no wire story carries it. If it were priced there would be a note cutting the lacutamab NPV for a two-quarter push of the Sezary accelerated-approval filing and of the up-to-USD-40m near-term Sobi milestones; instead the only rating action on file is an August upgrade. Formalising 'first patient early 2027' in a written H1 release converts a spoken remark into a disclosed timeline, which is when thin-tape holders act on it.
findings.independence: A query of the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API for 'lacutamab' returns only NCT04984837, NCT03902184 and NCT05321147 -- no TELLOMAK-3 record exists, which is independent corroboration that no patient has been enrolled: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.term=lacutamab (checked 2026-09-16).

findings.finding: PACIFIC-9's ClinicalTrials.gov record carries an estimated primary completion date of 2026-09-30 -- thirteen days after this print -- with enrollment already ACTUAL at 1,051 and status ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, and the 17 Sept call is the last scheduled management appearance before a monalizumab readout worth up to EUR 825m of milestones plus royalties against a ~$219m market cap.
findings.why_not_priced: The registry date and the company's own 'primary endpoint data before year-end' remark have not been joined up anywhere in the coverage -- the wire treats 17 Sept purely as a financial-results date. If the market had connected them, an unhedgeable binary worth roughly four times the market cap two weeks out would show up as a bid in the tape ahead of the print and as a sell-side preview framing 17 Sept as a PACIFIC-9 timing update; there is no such note, and the stock is still below the EUR 1.70 placement price struck a month ago. This is the one clearly positive leg and it is why the overall number is small rather than a clean negative.
findings.independence: AstraZeneca's own H1/Q2 2026 clinical trials appendix (2026-07-27) independently guides PACIFIC-9 data to H2 2026: https://www.astrazeneca.com/content/dam/az/PDF/2026/h1q2/H1-and-Q2-2026-results-clinical-trials-appendix.pdf

searched_and_found_nothing: Cause of today's move: IPHA was $1.97, +5.91% on 78,852 shares at 13:08 EDT on 2026-09-16 against a 20-day average of 25,021 -- roughly 3x volume with hours left -- and there is no press release, no 6-K and no dated analyst action behind it (the Leerink upgrade to Outperform, PT $4, is dated 2026-08-11). Unexplained, and I could not source it.

Short-squeeze setup: there is none. Short interest at the 2026-08-31 settlement was 81,961 shares, 0.1% of stock, 1.8 days to cover, down 63.9% from 227,041 on 15 August (https://www.dailypolitical.com/2026/09/13/innate-pharma-s-a-sponsored-adr-nasdaqipha-short-interest-update.html).
A hidden going-concern trigger independent of the Sobi closing -- the 14-Aug release already gives the pro-forma runway, so absent the closing condition there is no mechanical trigger.
Any new ATM, second tranche or additional capital-increase authorisation beyond the 17,647,059-share placement; nothing found in Innate's regulated-information releases after 2026-08-14.
PACIFIC-9 topline having already leaked or been released -- it has not; no AstraZeneca release exists.

A pipeline-decision or impairment angle: the pipeline prioritisation and the plan de sauvegarde de l'emploi were validated by the DREETS in December 2025 with layoffs completing April 2026, so the restructuring charge is old news, not an H1 surprise.
Hiring-page and LinkedIn signal for Phase 3 build-out -- Innate's careers listings could not be reliably dated, so I dropped the angle rather than guess.
Insider Form 4 / AMF dirigeants transaction clusters since the August placement -- nothing found, though I did not exhaust AMF's filing database.

Historical earnings reaction history: I could not retrieve IPHA closes around the real H1-2025 (2025-09-16/17) or FY-2025 (2026-03-25/26) prints from any reachable source, so I have NO genuine earnings base rate for this name and sized off realised vol (50.9% annualised, ~3.2% daily sigma) and information content instead.
baseline_tension: There is no skew and no option chain to agree or disagree with, and the baseline's own reaction history is unusable as instructed; my finding set cuts mildly against the tape, which is rallying into the print on ~3x volume with no wire story behind it, and it also cuts against the sweep's premise -- the cash-runway line it called 'the single most repriceable' was pre-announced five weeks ago, so my main conclusion is that this print carries less information than a semi-annual biotech print normally does, not that it is a big short.
